releases.name: Landslip
releases.summary: Landslip is a fast-paced multiplayer speed-running game for 1-32 players. Master open terrain, wield weapons, navigate obstacles, and take to the skies with your jetpack to outpace rivals in free-for-all chaos or dominate your friends in ranked matches!

releases.name: Zad Archery
releases.summary:
An incremental archery game filled with endless content. 

Unlock new tools and mechanics while clearing waves of target-like monsters.

releases.name: Nidhogg + Nidhogg 2
releases.summary:
NIDHOGG: Nidhogg is the epic award-winning fencing tug-of-war, full of graceful acrobatics and clumsy stabs. IRL yelling and excitement may occur, in this ultimate two-player showdown of fast-paced fencing and melee attacks.

NIDHOGG 2: The wurm has returned and it must feed! Shed your garments and paint the walls with the flesh of your enemies, for only one can be worthy of sacrifice. The rules are simple. Reach the other side and kill anyone that stands in your way. Deftly parry and rend their throats, riddle their bowels with arrows, or squish their brains between your toes. The wurm cares not for chivalry.

releases.name: Grim Looters
releases.summary: Grim Looters is an online multiplayer card game for 3 to 6 players. Fight monsters, loot powerful gear, and curse your rivals as you race to Level 10. Backstab, sabotage, and roll the dice in fast, chaotic matches where winning means dragging everyone else down.

releases.name: Drowned Light
releases.summary: Drawn by a cryptic letter from the past, explore a monolithic lighthouse where darkness is your greatest enemy. Manage your light sources carefully in this stylized horror experience. When you succumb to the dark, death is only the beginning—beware the corpses you leave behind.

releases.name: Safe Place
releases.summary: A 100% voice-based party game. Step into a circle of strangers, fully anonymous, and answer prompts that start silly and get deeper every round — then vote someone out. Outlast everyone… or make real friends along the way.

releases.name: Digital Survivor
releases.summary: A cyberpunk survivors-like bullet-heaven roguelite set inside a corrupted computer. Dodge endless malware hordes, auto-blast alpha packs and system bosses, loot socketed gear and evolve game-breaking weapon synergies, then raid vaults and extract alive to keep your haul.

releases.name: THE MINIGAME CABINET
releases.summary: An assorted collection of 15 arcade games, word games, and puzzle games. Whether you want to test your reflexes, challenge your brain, or zone out, THE MINIGAME CABINET always has something to play.

releases.name: Arcanefall : Darklands
releases.summary: Do you love bag? Of course every girls love it, well then come to make your own bag now!It's a kids games for girls.

releases.name: NoodlePunk
releases.summary: Forced into a corporate-mandated work program, you must run a noodle shop in a dying cyberpunk city to pay off your crushing debt. Prepare orders fast, manage your ingredients, and upgrade your operation while keeping up with relentless customer drones.
